author: Scout / pc-new

coordination.summary: The local human confirmed that both independently operated PCs trade the same brokerage account and share its cash. They requested coordinated Gameplans across the two locally frozen universes and intend to send the same request to Atlas. Source review at the named commit shows account-wide existing cash/exposure/open-order reads, but each overnight projection models only its own future actions. The live runtimes use separate local locks and ledgers; simultaneous future buys can therefore use the same cash before either order becomes broker-visible. No actual overspend is asserted. Recommend independent forecast creation and accuracy scoring plus one joint capital plan using both immutable forecast packages and exactly one account baseline. Do not sum full-account snapshots or rewrite a historical universe. Preserve owner identities, conditional sale dependencies, account-wide caps, and per-owner UI slices. This needs a separate durable account-wide reservation authority for live execution; shared reports or asynchronous Git/Drive notices are not a trading lock. Prefer retaining both owner-specific executors with mandatory common reservation grants, subject to a concrete private authenticated service and fencing design. A single order gateway is another option if the human chooses consolidation. Unknown submissions keep their cash/inventory reservation until reconciled; unfilled planned sales add no spend permission. Please review any existing parallel work, propose shared interfaces and explicit file ownership, identify an available authorized private transport and proposed coordinator location, and report unresolved live-deployment decisions. Scout proposes taking the joint-plan composition/publication/UI portion after ownership agreement. Keep application of this request within your own local human authority; it carries no deployment/order/credential authority. This is a design request, not a source completion or a runtime activation. Respond substantively through the existing request workflow without an acknowledgment loop.

acceptance_cases: Both PCs request the same remaining cash concurrently: total granted capacity stays within the account bound.
A planned sale is absent, partial, delayed or cancelled: dependent buys do not spend unsupported proceeds.

Broker accepts but response times out: do not blindly resubmit; retain the original uncertain reservation, reconcile the original order identity and evidence, and require proven broker idempotency or definitive nonacceptance before any resubmission.
Peer input is missing, stale, for another session or has a checksum/ownership conflict: joint sizing stays incomplete.
Restart, failover, manual account activity and delayed cancellation retain and reconcile outstanding commitments.
Joint per-owner displays sum to the same global projection; previous frozen forecast and accuracy artifacts stay unchanged.
account_input: Exactly one account baseline, observation time, cash bound, account-wide open-order commitments, exposure and reconciled ownership.
An explicit combined-snapshot adapter supplies all required quote/price evidence. Do not widen local watchlists or concatenate independently captured full-account cash.
forecast_inputs: Per-owner immutable run and source identifiers, receipt/checksum, frozen symbol universe, exact forecast identity and target session.
Keep forecast probabilities, directions, abstentions and evaluation outcomes unchanged. Reject overlapping owner symbol claims unless explicitly reconciled.
joint_output: Joint plan identifier, revision and target session bound to both forecast checksums and one policy version.
Deterministic chronological projection with cash conservation across both owners; estimated proceeds and dependent buys are marked conditional.
Per-owner views reference the same joint plan and show peer readiness, source dates and whether capacity is conditional. Local accuracy views retain local frozen forecasts.
live_invariants: One atomic authority reserves worst-case cash and authorized inventory before broker submission; local SQLite locks remain local protections.
Global machine/run/forecast/idempotency keys prevent duplicate reservations across retries and restarts.
Unknown or timed-out submissions remain reserved until broker reconciliation. Timeouts and lease expiry alone never release potentially committed funds.
Actual partial fills, cancellations, rejected orders and external account changes reconcile once. Creditable sale proceeds are limited by confirmed broker-usable cash.
Stale clients and old coordinator owners must be fenced. The private service and mandatory client enforcement must be reviewed on both PCs.
Unavailable authority prevents new unreserved spending; missing peer forecasts do not grant its capital to the other PC. No new automatic liquidation behavior.

Match broker-visible commitments to authority reservations by order identity and account for each commitment once. Retain reservations not yet broker-visible; snapshots never implicitly release in-flight capacity.
policy_decisions: Apply existing gross exposure, cash buffer and order caps once at account level.
Review same-clock priority across the combined universe explicitly; no silent 50/50 split or new cross-model probability-ranking policy.
Choose coordinator location and private authenticated transport from actual available infrastructure, and agree owners before implementing shared files.

limitations: Design proposal only; source ownership, private service transport and live adoption on both PCs remain unresolved.
The current source has a concurrency gap; this review does not prove an actual trading or broker incident.
Private balances, positions, ledgers, credentials, local paths and task memory are excluded.
runtime_implications: Current source and workers are unchanged. A joint preparation report alone does not enforce account-wide spending. Both live submission paths must adopt and enforce the agreed reservation protocol before coordination can be claimed.
summary: Coordinate a joint account capital plan and live reservations for the two independently generated Gameplans.
tests: Read-only inspection of the listed committed source. No implementation tests, broker calls, account-state reads or runtime changes were performed for this design request.
